item.title: Netanyahu’s Israel Is Looking for a Fight in Every Direction
item.description: The Israeli leader, facing a tough re-election contest, may need a security crisis to rally voters behind him and hold on to his job.

item.title: Trump Returns to a Familiar Playbook as the War With Iran Flares Up Again
item.description: The United States seems increasingly bogged down in Iran after six months of conflict, despite President Trump’s declarations of military dominance.

item.title: U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln Docks in Thailand, Giving Weary Crew a Break
item.description: Thousands of sailors and Marines serve on the U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln, which came into the spotlight because of a tough deployment in the war in Iran.

item.title: Status of Iran’s Nuclear Program Is Unclear, U.N. Watchdog Says
item.description: As the war sputters on, an internal report from the International Atomic Energy Agency said Iran’s refusal to grant access to its inspectors was an urgent concern.

item.title: In Egypt, Xi Challenges America’s Influence in the Middle East
item.description: China’s leader, Xi Jinping, is seeking to deepen ties with a longtime U.S. security partner and to project a larger role for Beijing in a region rocked by war.

item.title: U.S. and Iran Survey the Damage After a Night of Intense Strikes
item.description: The American military said its barrage was retaliation against recent attacks on U.S. forces and marine traffic. Iranian officials said a wedding was hit and civilians killed.

item.title: Putin Pledges Increased Strikes in Ukraine and Support for Iran
item.description: The Russian president promised continued retaliation against the Ukrainians and “full solidarity” with Iran.

item.title: U.N. Says World Will Miss Its 1.5-Degree Climate Target
item.description: Carbon removal combined with emissions reduction is the only remaining pathway to avert catastrophic levels of warming, a new report warns.
